comment: The e2e fixture saves (tests/e2e/fixtures), by hash; each a release asset of the private refs repository. scripts/fixtures.py fetches and blesses them (tests/e2e/README.md). Descriptions by kind only.

2minnow.sav.description: a mid-game Spaced Out colony on the Aquatic pack's cluster, cycle ~2,000, 50 Duplicants (30 MB)
2minnow.sav.game: Spaced Out, with the Frosty Planet, Bionic Booster, Prehistoric and Aquatic packs

U57.sav.description: a late-game Spaced Out sandbox colony, cycle ~17,000, 22 Duplicants, a very large built-up base (150 MB)
U57.sav.game: Spaced Out, with the Frosty Planet, Bionic Booster and Prehistoric packs
used_by: scripts/qa.sh verify, perf and memory (QA_U57_SAVE in out/local-tools/qa.env, else this fixture)

decrew.sav.description: a late-game base-game colony, cycle ~17,600, 15 Duplicants, busy gas and liquid networks (145 MB; about 4.5 minutes to load in the original)
used_by: scripts/qa.sh dogfood: colony, codex, management, research, naming, overlays, saveload, resize (scripts/qa-scenarios, scripts/m9-scenarios; ONI_M9_SAVE overrides)

early-base.sav.description: landing dug out on both sides of the pod, with an outhouse, a manual generator, an unpowered research station and a cot; debris on the floors
early-base.sav.game: Spaced Out, with the Frosty Planet, Bionic Booster, Prehistoric and Aquatic packs
used_by: most specs: the default for mod specs (2,250+ of them)
v1-current and v1-newer are made from it

gas-boundary.sav.description: landing with a sealed box of oxygen, carbon dioxide, chlorine and hydrogen side by side, mixed for 4 seconds
gas-boundary.sav.game: Spaced Out, with the Frosty Planet, Bionic Booster, Prehistoric and Aquatic packs

issue-45-old.sav.description: a mid-game colony with a Bonbon Tree branch in a cell its trunk occupies, cycle 150 (2.5 MB)
issue-45-old.sav.not_stored: the reporter's save attached to issue #45; copy it to tests/e2e/fixtures/issue-45-old.sav (issue-45-space-tree-branch.yaml)
